name: CreateDisk

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID. This parameter is required when you create a pay-as-you-go cloud disk in a specified zone.

If you do not specify InstanceId, ZoneId is required.
You cannot specify both ZoneId and InstanceId.


You do not need to specify ZoneId for a `cloud_regional_disk_auto` cloud disk
parameters.help_zh:
在指定可用区内创建一块按量付费磁盘。

如果您不设置InstanceId，则ZoneId为必填参数。
您不能同时指定ZoneId和InstanceId。


`cloud_regional_disk_auto`类型的磁盘无需设置 ZoneId
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the snapshot used to create the cloud disk. Snapshots created on or before July 15, 2013 cannot be used to create cloud disks. 

The `SnapshotId` and `Size` parameters have the following limits:

If snapshot size of the snapshot specified by `SnapshotId` is greater than the value of `Size`, snapshot size of the created cloud disk is equal to snapshot size of the snapshot.
If snapshot size of the snapshot specified by `SnapshotId` is less than the value of `Size`, snapshot size of the created cloud disk is equal to the value of `Size`.
You cannot use a snapshot to create an elastic ephemeral disk
parameters.help_zh:
创建云盘使用的快照ID。2013年7月15日及以前的快照不能用来创建云盘。 

`SnapshotId`参数和`Size`参数存在以下限制：

如果`SnapshotId`参数对应的快照容量大于设置的`Size`参数值，实际创建的云盘大小为指定快照的大小。
如果`SnapshotId`参数对应的快照容量小于设置的`Size`参数值，实际创建的云盘大小为指定的`Size`参数值。
不支持使用快照创建弹性临时盘
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the cloud disk. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters and digits. It can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘名称。长度为2~128个字符，支持Unicode中letter分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文等），ASCII数字（0-9）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。必须以Unicode中letter分类下的字符开头。

默认值：空
parameters.name: disk_name

parameters.help_en:
Snapshot size of the cloud disk. Unit: GiB. You must specify this parameter. Valid values:

cloud: 5 to 2,000.
cloud_efficiency: 20 to 32,768.
cloud_ssd: 20 to 32,768.
cloud_essd: The valid values vary based on the value of `PerformanceLevel`.
    - PL0: 1 to 65,536.
    - PL1: 20 to 65,536.
    - PL2: 461 to 65,536.
    - PL3: 1,261 to 65,536.
cloud_auto: 1 to 65,536.
cloud_essd_entry: 10 to 32,768.
cloud_regional_disk_auto: 10 to 65,536.
elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard: 64 to 8,192.
elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium: 64 to 8,192.

If you specify the `SnapshotId` parameter, the `SnapshotId` and `Size` parameters have the following limits:

If snapshot size of the snapshot specified by `SnapshotId` is greater than the value of `Size`, snapshot size of the created cloud disk is equal to snapshot size of the snapshot.
If snapshot size of the snapshot specified by `SnapshotId` is less than the value of `Size`, snapshot size of the created cloud disk is equal to the value of `Size`
parameters.help_zh:
容量大小。单位：GiB。您必须为该参数传入参数值。取值范围：

cloud：5~2,000。
cloud_efficiency：20~32,768。
cloud_ssd：20~32,768。
cloud_essd：具体取值范围与`PerformanceLevel`的取值有关。
    - PL0：1~65,536。
    - PL1：20~65,536。
    - PL2：461~65,536。
    - PL3：1,261~65,536。
cloud_auto：1~65,536。
cloud_essd_entry：10~32,768。
cloud_regional_disk_auto：10~65,536。
elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard：64～8,192。
elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium：64～8,192。

如果您指定了`SnapshotId`参数，`SnapshotId`参数和`Size`参数存在以下限制：

如果`SnapshotId`参数对应的快照容量大于设置的`Size`参数值，实际创建的云盘大小为指定快照的大小。
如果`SnapshotId`参数对应的快照容量小于设置的`Size`参数值，实际创建的云盘大小为指定的`Size`参数值
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
The category of the data cloud disk. Valid values:

cloud: basic cloud disk.
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: ESSD cloud disk.
cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL cloud disk.
cloud_essd_entry: ESSD Entry disk.
cloud_regional_disk_auto: regional ESSD cloud disk.
elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard: elastic ephemeral disk - Standard Edition.
elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium: elastic ephemeral disk - Premium Edition.

Default value: cloud
parameters.help_zh:
数据盘的磁盘种类。取值范围：

cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL云盘。
cloud_essd_entry：ESSD Entry云盘。
cloud_regional_disk_auto：ESSD同城冗余云盘。
elastic_ephemeral_disk_standard：弹性临时盘-标准版。
elastic_ephemeral_disk_premium：弹性临时盘-高级版。

默认值：cloud
parameters.name: disk_category

parameters.help_en:
The description of the cloud disk. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。

默认值：空
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the cloud disk. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否加密云盘。取值范围：

true：是。
false：否。

默认值：false
parameters.name: encrypted

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the subscription instance to which the subscription cloud disk is automatically attached.

After you specify the instance ID, the ResourceGroupId, Tag.N.Key, Tag.N.Value, ClientToken, and KMSKeyId parameters are ignored.
You cannot specify both ZoneId and InstanceId.

Default value: empty. An empty value indicates that a pay-as-you-go cloud disk is created. The region and zone of the cloud disk are determined by RegionId and ZoneId
parameters.help_zh:
创建一块包年包月磁盘，并自动挂载到指定的包年包月实例（InstanceId）上。

设置实例ID后，会忽略您设置的ResourceGroupId、Tag.N.Key、Tag.N.Value、ClientToken和KMSKeyId参数。
您不能同时指定ZoneId和InstanceId。

默认值：空，代表创建的是按量付费云盘，云盘所属地由RegionId和ZoneId确定
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the cloud disk belongs
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘所在的企业资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key used by the cloud disk.

If Encrypted is set to true and KMSKeyId is not specified, the default key is used for encryption, and the KMSKeyId value is returned after the instance is created.
- If the cloud disk is created from an unshared encrypted snapshot, the encryption key used by the snapshot is used by default.
- If the cloud disk is created from a shared encrypted snapshot, the service key is used by default.
- If the cloud disk is created in a region where account-level default encryption for Elastic Block Storage (EBS) is enabled, the specified account-level key is used by default.
- In other cases, the service key is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
云盘使用的KMS密钥ID。

若Encrypted设置为true，不指定KMSKeyId，则使用默认的密钥进行加密，并在创建实例成功后返回KMSKeyId值。
- 云盘通过非共享而来的加密快照创建：默认使用该快照所使用的加密密钥进行加密。
- 云盘通过共享而来的加密快照创建：默认使用服务密钥进行加密。
- 在已开启块存储账号级默认加密的地域创建：默认使用指定的账号级密钥进行加密。
- 其他情况：默认使用服务密钥进行加密
parameters.name: kms_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The performance level settings for the ESSD cloud disk. Valid values:

PL0: A single ESSD cloud disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: A single ESSD cloud disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: A single ESSD cloud disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: A single ESSD cloud disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Default value: PL1.

For more information about how to select a performance level for an ESSD cloud disk, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.help_zh:
创建一块ESSD云盘时，设置云盘的性能等级。取值范围：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万。
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万。
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万。
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万。

默认值：PL1。

有关如何选择ESSD性能等级，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: performance_level

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: advanced_features

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the storage set.

You can specify only one of the storage set parameters (`StorageSetId` and `StorageSetPartitionNumber`) and the dedicated block storage cluster parameter (`StorageClusterId`). If you specify both, the call fails
parameters.help_zh:
存储集ID。

存储集相关参数（`StorageSetId`、`StorageSetPartitionNumber`）与专属块存储集群参数（`StorageClusterId`）只能选择其中之一设置。如果同时设置，那么调用接口将会失败
parameters.name: storage_set_id

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: encrypt_algorithm

parameters.help_en:
The number of partitions in the storage set. Valid values: greater than or equal to 2. The maximum value cannot exceed the privilege quota limit displayed after you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73772.html operation.

Default value: 2
parameters.help_zh:
存储集分区数。取值范围：大于等于2，最高不能超过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73772.html后显示的权益配额限制。

默认值：2
parameters.name: storage_set_partition_number

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the dedicated block storage cluster. If you want to create a cloud disk in a specified dedicated block storage cluster, specify this parameter.

You can specify only one of the storage set parameters (`StorageSetId` and `StorageSetPartitionNumber`) and the dedicated block storage cluster parameter (`StorageClusterId`). If you specify both, the call fails
parameters.help_zh:
专属块存储集群ID。如果您需要在指定的专属块存储集群中创建云盘，请指定该参数。

存储集相关参数（`StorageSetId`、`StorageSetPartitionNumber`）与专属块存储集群参数（`StorageClusterId`）只能选择其中之一设置。如果同时设置，那么调用接口将会失败
parameters.name: storage_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the multi-mount feature. Valid values:

Disabled: does not enable the feature.
Enabled: enables the feature. Only ESSD cloud disks support this value.

Default value: Disabled.

Cloud disks for which the multi-mount feature is enabled support only the pay-as-you-go billing method. Therefore, when `MultiAttach` is set to `Enabled`, you cannot configure the settings for the `InstanceId` parameter. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25515.html operation to mount the cloud disk after it is created. Note that a cloud disk for which the multi-mount feature is enabled can be mounted only as a data cloud disk
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启多重挂载特性。取值范围：

Disabled: 不开启。
Enabled : 开启。目前仅ESSD云盘支持设置为`Enabled`。

默认值：Disabled。

开启多重挂载特性的云盘只支持按量付费的计费方式。因此`MultiAttach=Enabled `时，不能同时设置`InstanceId`参数。您可以在创建云盘后调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25515.html进行挂载，但需要注意开启多重挂载功能的云盘只能作为数据盘进行挂载
parameters.name: multi_attach

fields.help_en: The key of tag N of the cloud disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 磁盘的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入Tag.N.Key值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of tag N of the cloud disk. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 磁盘的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入Tag.N.Value值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag.

To improve code compatibility, we recommend that you use the Tag.N.Key parameter
fields.help_zh:
磁盘的标签键。

为提高代码兼容性，请尽量使用Tag.N.Key参数
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag.

To improve code compatibility, we recommend that you use the Tag.N.Value parameter
fields.help_zh:
磁盘的标签值。

为提高代码兼容性，请尽量使用Tag.N.Value参数
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the cloud disk
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘的标签信息列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数暂未开放使用
parameters.name: arn

parameters.help_en:
The read/write IOPS of the provisioned performance for a single ESSD AutoPL cloud disk. Valid values:

If the capacity is less than or equal to 3 GiB, you cannot configure the provisioned performance settings.

If the capacity is greater than or equal to 4 GiB, the valid values are 0 to min{(1,000 IOPS/GiB × Capacity - Baseline IOPS), 50,000}.


Baseline performance = max{min{1,800 + 50 × Capacity, 50,000}, 3,000}.


This parameter is supported only when `DiskCategory` is set to `cloud_auto`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
parameters.help_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘（单盘）预配置性能的读写IOPS。可能值：

容量（GiB）<=3：不支持设置预配置性能。

容量（GiB）>=4：[0，min{(1,000

 IOPS/GiB*容量-基准IOPS)，50,000}]


基准性能=max{min{1,800+50*容量，50,000}, 3,000}。


当`DiskCategory` = `cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
parameters.name: provisioned_iops

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the performance burst feature. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no.

This parameter is supported only when `DiskCategory` is set to `cloud_auto`. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启Burst（性能突发）。取值范围：

true：是。
false：否。

当`DiskCategory`取值为`cloud_auto`时才支持设置该参数。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/368372.html
parameters.name: bursting_enabled
